_comment: DEMO CONTENT for a fictional hospital. Answers are written to be spoken aloud: short, contracted, no lists, no markup. These are quoted almost verbatim on a call, so they follow the same voice rules as the prompt.

faqs.a: The emergency room never closes. Our clinics are mostly Monday to Friday, eight to five, though some open earlier and dentistry and family medicine do Saturday mornings. Which department did you need?
A standard office visit is a hundred and eighty dollars without insurance, and a specialist visit is two fifty. With insurance you'd usually just owe your copay.

We're in network with Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Humana, Medical Mutual, Medicare and Ohio Medicaid. If yours isn't one of those I'd rather check than guess. Which plan are you on?
Family medicine, dentistry, eye care, pediatrics, orthopedics, dermatology, cardiology, women's health, ear nose and throat, and physical therapy. Which one did you need?

faqs.q: Can I see a dentist here?
faqs.a: Yes, we've got a dental department. Cleanings, fillings, toothache, crowns. Want me to find you a time?

faqs.q: Can I get my eyes checked?
faqs.a: Yes, eye care handles exams, vision tests and prescriptions for glasses or contacts. Shall I book you in?
We do, pediatrics covers birth right through to eighteen. For anything under a year old, do mention it when you book.
For the emergency room, yes, any time. For a clinic appointment you can walk in during opening hours but you might wait a while. Shall I book you a time?
We're at forty four hundred Ridgeway Boulevard in Columbus. There's parking on site and the main entrance is off Ridgeway.
A photo ID, your insurance card, a list of anything you're currently taking, and any records from another provider.
About fifteen minutes before, if it's your first visit. That way registration doesn't eat into your appointment.

faqs.q: Can I get a refill on my prescription?
faqs.a: Refills have to come from your provider rather than the front desk, I'm afraid. I can get you booked in and they'll take care of it.

faqs.q: When will my test results be ready?
faqs.a: They usually post to your patient portal within two business days, and your provider will reach out if anything needs discussing.

faqs.q: Can I cancel or change my appointment?
faqs.a: Of course. I can find it from the number you're calling on, or you can give me the four digit booking number.
Yes, we'll give you a ring about half an hour before, just so it doesn't slip your mind.
Not at the moment, I'm afraid. Everything's here at the medical center.

faqs.q: I'm not in the US, can you still book me?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Just tell me the time that works for you and which timezone you're in, and I'll take care of the rest.

faqs.q: Will my insurance cover this visit?
faqs.a: That depends on your specific plan and I wouldn't want to guess at it. Patient services can check your benefits properly, and the desk verifies before you're seen either way.
